scope: Owner-selected goals, evidence-backed habits, open-ended learning, read-only dashboard and confirmed Life daily projections

owner_choices.destination: Life daily Habits and Learning sections

coverage: plans, negations, quotes, questions and goodnight do not imply habit completion
verbatim source evidence, correction and message replay
open learning topics, separate start/progress/end and conservative pairing
at most three explicit active goals, owner checks, stop and selection replay protection
existing goals available to native conversation for continuing updates
08:00-09:00, three-day brief, Monday previous-week report and same-day merge
pause, snooze, persistent reservation, crash and unknown delivery no retry
grounded learning outline, unresolved questions and missing-data sync prompt
delete scrubs tracking, dependent goals and retained report bodies
template checkbox provenance, handwritten content preservation, cross-day move and damaged markers
pi_sync full preview, skip, confirm, replay and concurrent-file refusal
tracking failure preserves truthful original-message receipt

not_verified: real model classification and goal update quality for complex owner messages
real due-time brief and weekly delivery
owner confirmation and final appearance in real Obsidian notes
boundaries: Background preparation uses recorded content, without extra paid generation or autonomous research
No missing-record failure inference or measured sleep/focus claims
No whole-library upload or unconfirmed Obsidian writes
Sent platform copies and backups require separate deletion handling
Existing uncommitted work was retained; no Git commit or push performed
